1.en: IV. The Truth of the Certainty of Itself
1.zh: IV. 自身确定性的真理

en: In the previous modes of certainty, the true is for consciousness something other than itself.

But the concept of this true vanishes in the experience of it; just as the object was immediately in itself — the existent of sense-certainty, the concrete thing of perception, the force of the understanding — so it proves rather not to be in truth, but this in-itself turns out to be a mode in which it is only for an other; the concept of it, or the first immediate representation in experience, is sublated on the actual object, and the certainty was lost in the truth.

But now that has come to be which did not come about in these earlier relations, namely a certainty that is equal to its truth; for the certainty is itself its own object, and consciousness is itself the true.
In this there is indeed also an otherness; for consciousness does distinguish, but such an otherness as is at the same time an undifferentiated for it.
If we call the movement of knowing the concept, and knowing as calm unity or as I the object, we see that not only for us but for knowing itself the object corresponds to the concept.

— Or, put the other way, if what the object is in itself is called the concept, and what it is as object or for an other is called the object, then it is evident that being-in-itself and being-for-an-other are the same; for the in-itself is consciousness; but it is likewise that for which an other (the in-itself) is; and it is for it that the in-itself of the object and its being for an other are the same; I is the content of the relation and the relating itself; it is itself over against an other, and at the same time reaches beyond this other, which for it is likewise only itself.
zh: 在以往的种种确定性方式里，真的东西对意识来说是某种不同于它自身的东西。
但是，这个真的东西的概念在对它的经验中消失了；正如对象当初直接地是自在的，即感性确定性的存在者、知觉的具体之物、知性的力，它反倒表明自己并不真的存在，而这个自在却表明为它只对一个他者存在的一种方式；关于它的概念，或者说经验中那第一个直接的表象，在现实的对象上被扬弃了，而确定性则在真理中消失了。
但现在，那个在这些较早的关系中不曾出现的东西产生了，即一种与其真理相等的确定性；因为确定性自己就是自己的对象，而意识自己就是真的东西。
这里面固然也有一种他在；因为意识在作区分，但这种他在对它来说同时又不是有差别的东西。
如果我们把知识的运动称为概念，而把知识作为静止的统一、或作为我，称为对象，那么我们就会看到，不仅对我们来说，而且对知识本身来说，对象都符合于概念。

——或者换一种说法：如果把概念称为对象自在所是的东西，而把对象称为它作为对象、或对一个他者而言所是的东西，那么就可以看出，自在存在与为他存在是同一个东西；因为自在就是意识；但它同样是那样一种东西：一个他者（即自在）对它来说存在着；而且对它来说，对象的自在与对象为一个他者而存在是同一个东西；我是关系的内容，也是关联活动本身；它面对一个他者而就是它自己，同时又越过这个他者，而这个他者对它来说同样只是它自己。

en: With self-consciousness, then, we have now entered the native realm of truth.
It is to be seen how the shape of self-consciousness first appears.

If we consider this new shape of knowing, the knowing of itself, in relation to the preceding one, the knowing of an other, then the latter has indeed vanished; but its moments have at the same time likewise been preserved, and the loss consists in this, that they are here present as they are in themselves.

The being of meaning, the singularity and the universality of perception opposed to it, as well as the empty inner of the understanding, are no longer as essences, but as moments of self-consciousness, that is, as abstractions or differences which for consciousness itself are at the same time null, or no differences, and purely vanishing essences.
Thus it seems that only the main moment itself has been lost, namely the simple independent subsistence for consciousness.
But in fact self-consciousness is the reflection out of the being of the sensuous and perceived world, and essentially the return out of otherness.

As self-consciousness it is movement; but since it distinguishes only itself from itself as itself, the difference is immediately sublated for it as an otherness; the difference is not, and it is only the motionless tautology of: I am I; since the difference does not also have for it the shape of being, it is not self-consciousness; it is hereby for it the otherness as a being or as a distinguished moment, but it is for it also the unity of itself with this difference as a second distinguished moment.

With that first moment, self-consciousness as consciousness, and for it the whole expanse of the sensuous world, is preserved, but at the same time only as related to the second moment, the unity of self-consciousness with itself; and this expanse is hereby for it a subsistence which, however, is only appearance or difference that in itself has no being.

But this opposition of its appearance and its truth has as its essence only the truth, namely the unity of self-consciousness with itself; this must become essential to it, that is, it is desire in general.

Consciousness as self-consciousness now has a doubled object: the one, the immediate, the object of sense-certainty and of perceiving, which is, however, marked for it with the character of the negative; and the second, namely itself, which is the true essence and to begin with is present only in opposition to the first.
Self-consciousness presents itself herein as the movement in which this opposition is sublated and in which the equality of itself with itself comes to be for it.
zh: 于是，随着自我意识，我们现在已经进入了真理的故乡。
我们要看看，自我意识的形态最初是怎样出现的。
如果我们把这种知识的新形态，即关于自身的知识，与先前的东西、即关于一个他者的知识联系起来考察，那么后者固然已经消失了；但它的各个环节同时也同样被保存了下来，而损失就在于：它们在这里正像它们自在所是的那样存在着。
意谓的存在、知觉的单一性及其与之相对立的普遍性，以及知性的空洞内在，都不再作为本质，而是作为自我意识的环节，也就是说，作为一些抽象或差别，这些抽象或差别对意识本身来说同时是虚无的、或者说并不是差别，并且是纯粹消逝着的本质。
于是看起来，只有那个主要环节本身丧失了，即那种对意识而言的单纯而独立的持存。
但事实上，自我意识是从感性的和被知觉的世界的存在中出来的反思，并且本质上是从他在中返回。
作为自我意识，它是运动；但既然它只是把自身作为自身与自身区别开来，那么差别对它来说就直接作为他在而被扬弃了；差别不存在，而它只是“我是我”这一不动的同语反复；既然差别对它来说并不同时具有存在的形态，它就不是自我意识；因此，对它来说，他在就是作为一种存在、或作为一个有差别的环节，但它对它来说同时也是它自身与这个差别的统一，作为第二个有差别的环节。
有了那第一个环节，自我意识作为意识，以及感性世界对它而言的整个展开，都保留下来了，但同时只是与第二个环节、即自我意识与自身的统一相关联；而它因此对它来说是一种持存，但这种持存只是现象或差别，而后者自在并没有存在。
但是，它的现象与它的真理之间的这个对立，只以真理、即自我意识与自身的统一为自己的本质；这个统一必须对它成为本质性的，也就是说，它就是一般的欲望。
意识作为自我意识现在有了一个双重的对象：一个是直接的对象，即感性确定性和知觉的对象，但它对意识来说带有否定的特征；另一个就是它自己，而它自己是真的本质，并且最初只是在对第一个对象的对立中才存在。
自我意识在这里表现为这样一种运动：在这个运动中，这个对立被扬弃了，而它自身与自身的等同则对它产生出来。

en: But the object which is the negative for self-consciousness has for its part, for us or in itself, likewise withdrawn into itself, just as consciousness on the other hand has.
Through this reflection-into-itself it has become life.

What self-consciousness distinguishes from itself as existent has, precisely insofar as it is posited as existent, not merely the mode of sense-certainty and of perception about it, but is being reflected into itself, and the object of immediate desire is a living thing.
For the in-itself, or the universal result of the relation of the understanding to the inner of things, is the distinguishing of what is not to be distinguished, or the unity of the distinguished.

But this unity is, as we have seen, just as much its repelling of itself from itself, and this concept divides itself into the opposition of self-consciousness and life: the former the unity for which the infinite unity of the differences is; the latter, however, is only this unity itself, so that it is not at the same time for itself.
As independent, then, as consciousness is, so independent is its object in itself.

Self-consciousness, which is absolutely for itself and marks its object immediately with the character of the negative, or is to begin with desire, will therefore rather make the experience of the independence of that object.
zh: 但是，那个对自我意识来说是否定物的对象，就它那一方面说，对我们或自在地也同样已经返回自身之内，正如意识在另一方面所做的那样。
它通过这种自身反思变成了生命。
自我意识作为存在者而与自身区别开来的东西，也就它是被设定为存在者而言，在它身上并不只具有感性确定性和知觉的方式，而是它是在自身中被反思的存在，而直接欲望的对象是一个有生命的东西。
因为自在、或者说知性与物的内在的关系的那个普遍结果，就是不可区分者的区分活动，或者说有差别者的统一。
但是，正如我们已经看到的，这个统一同样也是它从自身那里的排斥，而这个概念分裂为自我意识与生命的对立：前者是那种统一，诸差别的无限统一是为它而存在的；后者则只是这个统一本身，以至于它并不同时是自为的。
所以，意识有多独立，它的对象自在地也就有多独立。
因此，那个绝对自为地存在、并且直接给自己的对象打上否定特征、或者说最初就是欲望的自我意识，反倒会取得关于对象独立性的经验。

en: The determination of life, as it results from the concept or the general result with which we enter this sphere, is sufficient to designate it, without its nature being further developed from it; its circle closes in the following moments.

The essence is infinity as the sublatedness of all differences, the pure axis-turning movement, the rest of itself as absolutely unresting infinity; independence itself, in which the differences of the movement are dissolved; the simple essence of time, which in this self-equality has the solid shape of space.

But the differences are at this simple universal medium just as much as differences; for this universal fluidity has its negative nature only insofar as it is a sublating of them; but it cannot sublate the distinguished ones if they do not have a subsistence.
This very fluidity, as the self-equal independence, is itself the subsistence or the substance of the latter, in which they are thus as distinguished members and parts existing for themselves.

Being no longer has the meaning of the abstraction of being, nor their pure essentiality that of the abstraction of universality; rather their being is precisely that simple fluid substance of pure movement within itself.
But the difference of these members from one another as difference consists in general in no other determinacy than the determinacy of the moments of infinity or of pure movement itself.
zh: 生命的规定，即从我们借以进入这个领域的那个概念、或者说那个普遍结果中得出的规定，足以标示生命，而不必再由此展开它的本性；它的圆圈在下面这些环节中封闭起来。
本质是无限性，即一切差别的被扬弃状态，是纯粹绕轴旋转的运动，是它自身作为绝对不安宁的无限性的静止；是独立性本身，运动的诸差别在它之中消解了；是时间的单纯本质，而时间在这种自身等同中具有空间的坚实形态。
但是，这些差别在这个单纯的普遍介质上同样也是作为差别而存在的；因为这种普遍的流动性只有就它是这些差别的扬弃而言才具有自己的否定本性；但如果那些被区分者没有一种持存，它就不能扬弃它们。
正是这种流动性，作为自身等同的独立性，本身就是那些差别的持存、或者说它们的实体，而它们在其中因此就是作为有区分的肢体和自为存在的部分而存在的。
存在不再具有存在的抽象这一含义，它们的纯粹本质性也不再具有普遍性抽象这一含义；相反，它们的存在正是那种纯粹在自身之内运动的、单纯而流动的实体。
但是，这些肢体相互之间的差别作为差别，一般来说并不存在于别的任何规定性中，而只存在于无限性诸环节、或者说纯粹运动本身的规定性中。

en: The independent members are for themselves; but this being-for-themselves is, just as immediately, their reflection into the unity, as this unity is the diremption into the independent shapes.
The unity is split, because it is absolutely negative or infinite unity; and because it is subsistence, difference too has independence only in it.
This independence of the shape appears as something determinate, for an other, for it is something split; and the sublating of the split thus takes place through an other.

But it is just as much on the shape itself; for that very fluidity is the substance of the independent shapes; but this substance is infinite; the shape is therefore, in its subsistence itself, the diremption or the sublating of its being-for-itself.
zh: 这些独立的成员是自为的；但这种自为存在却同样直接地就是它们向统一中的反思，正如这种统一就是分裂为各个独立形态。
统一是分裂开的，因为它是绝对否定的或无限的统一；而因为它是持存，所以差别也只有在它那里才有独立性。
形态的这种独立性显现为某种被规定的、为他者的东西，因为它是分裂开来的；而分裂的扬弃就此是通过一个他者发生的。
但它同样也在这形态自己身上；因为那种流动性正是各个独立形态的实体；但这种实体是无限的；因此形态在它的持存中本身也就是分裂，或者说就是它自为存在的扬弃。

en: If we distinguish more closely the moments contained herein, we see that as the first moment we have the subsistence of the independent shapes, or the suppression of what distinguishing is in itself, namely not to be in itself and to have no subsistence.
The second moment, however, is the subjection of that subsistence under the infinity of difference.

In the first moment there is the subsisting shape; as being-for-itself, or as infinite substance in its determinacy, it comes forward against the universal substance, disowns this fluidity and continuity with it, and asserts itself as not dissolved in this universal, but rather as preserving itself through the separation from this its inorganic nature and through the consuming of it.
Life in the universal fluid medium, a calm laying-apart of the shapes, thereby becomes their movement, or life as process.
Simple universal fluidity is the in-itself, and the difference of the shapes the other.

But this fluidity itself becomes the other through this difference; for it is now for the difference, which is in and for itself and therefore the infinite movement, by which that calm medium is consumed — life as living.

– But this inversion is therefore again the perversity in itself: what is consumed is the essence; the individuality that preserves itself at the expense of the universal and gives itself the feeling of its unity with itself thereby precisely sublates its opposition to the other, through which it is for itself; the unity with itself that it gives itself is precisely the fluidity of the differences, or the universal dissolution.
But conversely, the sublating of individual subsistence is just as much the producing of it.

For since the essence of the individual shape, universal life, and the being-for-itself is in itself simple substance, it, in positing the other in itself, sublates this its simplicity or its essence, that is, it dirempts it, and this dirempting of the undifferentiated fluidity is precisely the positing of individuality.

The simple substance of life is therefore the diremption of itself into shapes and at the same time the dissolution of these subsisting differences; and the dissolution of the diremption is just as much a dirempting or an articulating.

Thereby the two sides of the whole movement that were distinguished fall into one another, namely the shaping calmly laid apart in the universal medium of independence and the process of life; the latter is just as much shaping as it is the sublating of the shape; and the first, shaping, is just as much a sublating as it is the articulation.
The fluid element is itself only the abstraction of the essence, or it is actual only as shape; and that it articulates itself is again a dirempting of the articulated, or a dissolving of it.

This whole circuit constitutes life – neither what is first expressed, the immediate continuity and solidity of its essence, nor the subsisting shape and the being-for-itself of the discrete, nor the pure process of these, nor again the simple gathering-together of these moments, but the whole that develops itself and dissolves its development and in this movement simply preserves itself.
zh: 如果我们更切近地区分这里包含的各个环节，就会看到，我们作为第一个环节所拥有的是各个独立形态的持存，或者说是对区分自在地所是的东西的压制，也就是自在地不存在、并且没有任何持存。
而第二个环节则是把那种持存置于差别的无限性之下。
在第一个环节里，存在的是持存着的形态；它作为自为存在着的实体、或者说作为在它的规定性中无限的实体，站出来与普遍实体相对，否认这种流动性以及自己与它的连续性，并且坚持自己并没有消解在这个普遍者之中，而是毋宁通过从自己这种无机自然中分离出来、并通过吞噬这种自然来维持自己。
在普遍的流动介质中的生命，也就是把各个形态宁静地分开放置，正因此就变成了它们的运动，或者说变成了作为过程的生命。
单纯的普遍流动性是自在，而各形态的差别则是他者。
但这种流动性本身通过这种差别而变成了他者；因为它现在是为着差别的，而这个差别是自在自为的，因此就是那种无限的运动，那种宁静的介质就是被它吞噬掉的，也就是作为活生生者的生命。
——但这种颠倒因此又是自在的颠倒：被吞噬掉的是本质；那种靠牺牲普遍者来维持自己、并给自己以它与自身统一的感觉的个体性，恰恰由此扬弃了它那种与他者的对立，而它正是通过这种对立才自为的；它给自己提供的与自身的统一，恰恰就是各种差别的流动性，或者说就是普遍的消解。
但反过来说，个体持存的扬弃同样就是这种持存的产生。
因为个体形态的本质，也就是普遍生命，以及自为存在者，自在地就是单纯的实体，所以当它把那个他者设定到自身之中时，它便扬弃了它这种单纯性、或者说它的本质，也就是说，它把这种单纯性分裂开来，而这种对无差别的流动性的分裂，恰恰就是个体性的设定。
所以，生命的单纯实体就是它自身分裂为各个形态，同时也是这些持存着的差别的消解；而分裂的消解同样就是一种分裂，或者说就是一种成员划分。
这样一来，整个运动的那两个被区分开来的方面，也就是在独立性的普遍介质中宁静地分开摆放的形态塑造和生命的过程，就相互落入对方之中；后者同样就是形态塑造，正如它是形态的扬弃；而前者，也就是形态塑造，同样就是一种扬弃，正如它是成员划分。
流动的要素本身只是本质的抽象，或者说它只有在作为形态时才是现实的；而它把自己划分为成员，这又是一种对已被划分成成员者的分裂，或者说是一种对它的消解。
这整个循环构成了生命，——既不是最初被说出来的东西，也就是它自己本质的直接连续性和坚实性，也不是持存着的形态和自为存在着的分立的东西，也不是这些东西的纯粹过程，更不是对各个环节的单纯概括，而是那个自身发展着、又消解着自己的发展、并在这运动中单纯地维持着自己的整体。

en: In that we start from the first immediate unity and, passing through the moments of shaping and of process, return to the unity of these two moments and thereby again to the first simple substance, this reflected unity is another than the first.
As against that immediate unity, or one expressed as a being, this second is the universal, which has all these moments in it as sublated.

It is the simple genus, which in the movement of life itself does not exist for itself as this simple thing; on the contrary, in this result life points to an other than it is, namely to consciousness, for which it is as this unity or as genus.
zh: 既然我们从最初直接的统一出发，穿过形态塑造和过程这两个环节，回到这两个环节的统一，并由此重新回到最初单纯的实体，那么这种经过反思的统一就是与最初那个统一不同的另一个统一。
相对于那个直接的、或者说被表述为存在的统一，这第二个统一则是普遍的，它把所有这些环节都作为被扬弃了的东西包含在自身之中。
它是单纯的类，而它在生命自身的运动中并不自为地作为这种单纯的东西存在；相反，在这个结果中，生命指向一个不同于它自身的他者，也就是指向意识，对意识来说，生命是作为这种统一、或者说作为类而存在的。

en: But this other life, for which the genus as such is and which is for itself itself genus, namely self-consciousness, is to itself at first only as this simple essence, and has itself as pure I for its object; in its experience, which is now to be considered, this abstract object will be enriched for it and receive the unfolding that we have seen in the case of life.
zh: 但这种另外的生命，即那种类本身为之存在、并且它自己自为地就是类的生命，也就是自我意识，它起初对自己来说只是这种单纯的本质，并且以自己、也就是纯粹的自我为对象；在它那现在有待考察的经验中，这个抽象的对象将对它变得丰富起来，并获得我们在生命那里已经看到的那种展开。

en: The simple I is this genus, or the simple universal for which the differences are none, only in that it is the negative essence of the formed independent moments; and self-consciousness is thereby certain of itself only through the sublating of this other, which presents itself to it as independent life; it is desire.

Certain of the nullity of this other, it posits that nullity for itself as its truth, annihilates the independent object, and thereby gives itself the certainty of itself as true certainty, as one that has come to be for it in an objective way.
zh: 单纯的我是这个类，或者说就是那个单纯的普遍者，对它来说各种差别都不存在，而这仅仅在于它是各个有形态的、独立的环节的否定本质；而自我意识由此只有通过扬弃这个在它面前显现为独立生命的他者，才确信自身；它就是欲望。
它确信这个他者的虚无性，就为自己把这种虚无性设定为自己的真理，消灭这个独立的对象，并由此给自己以对自身的确定性，作为真的确定性，作为这样一种对它自己以对象性的方式产生出来的确定性。

en: But in this satisfaction it has the experience of the independence of its object.
Desire, and the certainty of itself attained in its satisfaction, is conditioned by the object, for it is through the sublating of this other; for this sublating to be, this other must be.
Self-consciousness therefore cannot, through its negative relation, sublate the object; it therefore rather produces it again, just as desire does.
It is in fact a
other than self-consciousness, the essence of desire; and through this experience this truth itself has come to be for it.
At the same time, however, it is just as absolutely for itself, and is this only through the sublating of the object, and its satisfaction must come to be for it, for it is the truth.

On account of the independence of the object, it can therefore attain satisfaction only in that this object itself carries out the negation on it; and the object must carry out this negation of itself on itself, for it is in itself the negative, and must be for the other what it is.
In that it is the negation on itself and therein is at the same time independent, it is consciousness.
On life, which is the object of desire, the negation is either on an other, namely on desire, or as determinacy against another indifferent shape, or as its inorganic universal nature.
But this universal independent nature, on which the negation is as absolute, is the genus as such, or as self-consciousness.
Self-consciousness attains its satisfaction only in another self-consciousness.
zh: 但在这种满足中，它经验到了它对象的独立性。
欲望以及它在满足中达到的对自身的确定性，都是由对象制约的，因为它们要靠扬弃这个他者才成立；而这种扬弃要存在，这个他者就必须存在。
所以，自我意识通过它那种否定的关系并不能扬弃对象；因此它反倒又把它产生出来，正如欲望一样。
它事实上是一个
不同于自我意识的他者，也就是欲望的本质；而通过这种经验，这个真理本身对它自己也已经生成。
但与此同时，它同样绝对地是自为的，并且只有通过扬弃对象才如此，而且它必须获得自己的满足，因为它就是真理。
由于对象的独立性，所以它只有在这个对象自身对它实行否定时才能达到满足；而这个对象必须在自身身上实行这种对它自身的否定，因为它自在地就是否定的东西，并且必须为那个他者而是它所是的东西。
既然它是在自身身上的否定，并且同时在其中是独立的，它就是意识。
在生命身上，也就是在欲望的对象身上，否定要么是在一个他者身上，也就是在欲望身上，要么是作为规定性而针对另一个漠不相关的形态，要么是作为它那种无机的普遍自然。
但这种普遍的、独立的自然，也就是否定作为绝对的东西而存在于其上的那种自然，就是类本身，或者说就是作为自我意识的类。
自我意识只有在另一个自我意识中才达到自己的满足。

en: In these three moments the concept of self-consciousness is first completed: a) pure, undifferentiated I is its first immediate object, b) but this immediacy is itself absolute mediation, it is only as the sublating of the independent object, or it is desire.

The satisfaction of desire is indeed the reflection of self-consciousness into itself, or the certainty that has become truth, c) but its truth is rather the doubled reflection, the doubling of self-consciousness.
It is an object for consciousness which in itself posits its otherness, or the difference, as something null, and therein is independent.

The differentiated, merely living shape does indeed also sublate its independence in the process of life, but with its difference it ceases to be what it is; the object of self-consciousness, however, is just as independent in this negativity of itself; and thereby it is for itself genus, universal fluidity in the peculiarity of its separation; it is living self-consciousness.
zh: 在这三个环节里，自我意识的概念才第一次完成：a) 纯粹而无差别的我是它第一个直接的对象，b) 但这种直接性本身却是绝对的中介，它只作为对独立对象的扬弃而存在，或者说，它就是欲望。
欲望的满足虽然是自我意识在自身中的反思，或者是变成了真理的确定性，c) 但它的真理却毋宁是双重的反思，是自我意识的双重化。
它是意识的一个对象，这个对象在自身那里把自己的他在、或把差别设定为虚无的东西，并因此在其中是独立的。
有差别的、仅仅活着的形态，在生命的过程中确实也扬弃了自己的独立性，但它随着自己的差别就不再是它之所是；而自我意识的对象在这种自身的否定性中同样是独立的；因此它对自己来说就是类，是在其分离的独特性中普遍的流动性；它就是活着的自我意识。

en: It is a self-consciousness for a self-consciousness.

Only through this is it in fact; for only herein does the unity of itself in its otherness come to be for it; the I, which is the object of its concept, is in fact not an object; the object of desire, however, is only independent, for it is the universal, indelible substance, the fluid, self-same essence.
Insofar as a self-consciousness is the object, it is just as much I as object.
— With this, the concept of spirit is already present for us.

What further comes to be for consciousness is the experience of what spirit is, this absolute substance, which in the perfect freedom and independence of its opposition, namely of different self-consciousnesses that are for themselves, is the unity of these; I that is We, and We that is I.

Consciousness has its turning point only in self-consciousness, as the concept of spirit, the point at which it steps out of the colourful semblance of the sensuous here-and-now and out of the empty night of the supersensuous beyond into the spiritual day of the present.
zh: 它是为一个自我意识而存在的自我意识。
只有通过这一点，它才事实上存在；因为只有在这里，它自身在它的他在中的统一才对它产生出来；我，作为它的概念的对象，事实上并不是对象；但欲望的对象却只是独立的，因为它是普遍的、不可消灭的实体，是流动的、自身等同的本质。
由于一个自我意识是对象，它同样既是我，也是对象。
——由此，精神的概念对我们来说已经存在了。
对意识来说接下来产生出来的东西，是经验，即精神是什么的经验：这个绝对的实体，在它的对立面、即各个自为存在的自我意识的完全自由和独立性中，是它们的统一；Ich, das Wir, und Wir, das Ich ist。
意识只有在自我意识中、作为精神的概念，才有它的转折点，在这一点上，它从感性此岸的多彩假象中、从超感性彼岸的空虚黑夜中，踏入当下的精神的白昼。

14.en: A. Independence and Dependence of Self-Consciousness; Lordship and Bondage
14.zh: A. 自我意识的独立性与非独立性；主人与奴隶

en: Self-consciousness is in and for itself insofar as and through the fact that it is in and for itself for another; that is, it is only as something recognized.

The concept of this its unity in its doubling, of the infinity that realizes itself in self-consciousness, is a many-sided and ambiguous intertwining, so that its moments must in part be kept precisely apart, and in part, in this distinction, must at the same time be taken and cognized as not distinguished, or always in their opposite meaning.
The double meaning of the differentiated lies in the essence of self-consciousness: to be, infinitely or immediately, the opposite of the determinacy in which it is posited.
The unfolding of the concept of this spiritual unity in its doubling presents to us the movement of recognition.
zh: 自我意识是自在自为的，只要并且通过这一点，即它是为一个他者而自在自为的；也就是说，它只作为被承认者而存在。
这种统一在它的双重化中的概念，也就是在自我意识中实现自身的无限性，是一种多方面的、多义的交织，以至于它的这些环节一部分必须被精确地彼此分开，一部分又必须在这种区分中同时被看作、被认识到是没有区分的，或者始终是在它们相反的含义中被把握的。
被区分开的东西的双重含义在于自我意识的本质：无限地或者直接地成为它所被设定于其中的那种规定性的反面。
把这种精神的统一在它的双重化中的概念展开，就向我们呈现出承认的运动。

en: There is for self-consciousness another self-consciousness; it has come outside itself.

This has a double meaning: first, it has lost itself, for it finds itself as another essence; secondly, it has thereby sublated the other, for it does not see the other as essence either, but itself in the other.
zh: 对自我意识来说，出现了另一个自我意识；它已经走到自身之外了。
这有双重的含义：第一，它失去了自己，因为它发现自己是一个其他的本质；第二，它由此扬弃了他者，因为它也不把他者看作本质，而是在他者中看到自己。

en: It must sublate this its otherness; this is the sublating of the first double meaning and therefore itself a second double meaning; first, it must aim at sublating the other independent essence, in order thereby to become certain of itself as of the essence; secondly, it thereby aims at sublating itself, for this other is itself.
zh: 它必须扬弃自己的这个他在；这是对第一种双重含义的扬弃，因此本身又是第二种双重含义；第一，它必须致力于扬弃那另一个独立的本质，以便由此确信自己是本质；第二，它由此致力于扬弃自己，因为这个他者就是它自己。

en: This double-meaning sublating of its double-meaning otherness is likewise a double-meaning return into itself, for first, through the sublating it gets itself back, for it becomes equal to itself again through the sublating of its otherness; secondly, however, it likewise gives the other self-consciousness back to it again, for it was itself in the other, it sublates this its being in the other, and thus releases the other again, letting it be free.
zh: 对它那双重含义的他在的这种双重含义的扬弃，同样是向自身的一种双重含义的返回，因为第一，它通过这种扬弃重新获得自己，因为它通过对自己的他在的扬弃重新变得与自身相等；第二，它同样也把另一个自我意识重新还给了它，因为它在那个他者中曾是自己，它扬弃了它在那个他者中的这种存在，于是又把他者释放出来，让它重新自由。

en: This movement of self-consciousness in its relation to another self-consciousness has, however, in this way been represented as the doing of the one; but this doing of the one has itself the double meaning of being just as much its doing as the doing of the other; for the other is just as independent, self-contained, and there is nothing in it that is not through itself.

The first does not have before it the object as it is at first only for desire, but a self-subsistent, independent one, over which it therefore can do nothing for itself unless the object itself does to itself what the first does to it.
The movement is therefore absolutely the doubled movement of both self-consciousnesses.

Each sees the other do the same as it does; each itself does what it demands of the other, and therefore does what it does only insofar as the other does the same; one-sided doing would be useless, because what is to happen can come about only through both.
zh: 自我意识在它与另一个自我意识的关系中的这种运动，却是以这种方式被表象的，即它是一方所做的；但这一方所做的本身就有双重的含义，即它同样是一方所做的、也是另一方所做的；因为另一方同样独立、自身封闭，在它之中没有什么东西不是通过它自己而来的。
前者面前的对象并不是它最初仅仅在欲望那里所是的那样，而是一个自为存在的、独立的对象，因此，如果这个对象不在自身中做前者对它所做的这件事，前者对它就不能为自己做出任何事。
所以这运动绝对地是双方自我意识的双重运动。
每一方都看到另一方做和自己所做的相同的事；每一方自己都在做它要求另一方做的事，因此它做它所做的事，也仅仅是由于另一方做同样的事；单方面的行动会是无用的，因为应当发生的事只能通过双方才能实现。

en: The doing is therefore double-meaning not only insofar as it is a doing directed just as much against itself as against the other, but also insofar as it is, inseparably, just as much the doing of the one as of the other.
zh: 所以，这种行动不仅就它同样既是针对自己、也是针对他者的行动而言是双重含义的，而且就它不可分割地同样既是一方的行动、也是另一方的行动而言，也是双重含义的。

en: In this movement we see the process repeat itself that presented itself as the play of forces, but in consciousness.
What was in that case for us is here for the extremes themselves.
The middle is self-consciousness, which decomposes itself into the extremes; and each extreme is this exchange of its determinacy and absolute transition into the opposite.
As consciousness, however, it does indeed come outside itself, yet in its being-outside-itself it is at the same time held back within itself, for itself, and its being-outside-itself is for it.

It is for it that it immediately is and is not another consciousness; and likewise that this other is only for itself insofar as it sublates itself as being-for-itself and is for itself only in the being-for-itself of the other.

Each is the middle for the other, through which each mediates and closes itself with itself, and each is for itself and for the other an immediate, being-for-itself essence, which at the same time is so for itself only through this mediation.
They recognize themselves as mutually recognizing one another.
zh: 在这个运动里，我们看到那个曾表现为力的游戏的过程又重复了一遍，不过是在意识中。
在那里面为我们而存在的东西，在这里是为两个极端本身而存在的。
中项是自我意识，它把自己分解为两个极端；而每一个极端都是它的规定性的这种交换，是向对立面的绝对过渡。
但作为意识，它确实来到自身之外，然而它在自己在自身之外的存在中同时又保持在自身之内，是自为的，而它的在自身之外是为它而存在的。
对它来说，事情是这样：它直接地是另一个意识，又不是另一个意识；同样，这个他者只有通过把自己作为自为存在者加以扬弃，才是自为的，并且只有在另一方的自为存在中才是自为的。
每一方对另一方来说都是中项，通过这个中项，每一方都与自身中介并结合起来，而每一方对自己和对另一方来说都是直接的、自为存在着的本质，这个本质同时只有通过这种中介才是如此自为的。
它们承认自己为相互承认着对方的。

en: This pure concept of recognition, the doubling of self-consciousness within its unity, is now to be considered as its process appears for self-consciousness.

It will first present the side of the inequality of the two, or the stepping-forth of the middle into the extremes, which as extremes are opposed to one another and of which the one is only what is recognized, the other only what recognizes.
zh: 这个纯粹的承认概念，即自我意识在其统一中的双重化，现在要来看它的过程如何为自我意识而显现。
它首先会展示出两者不平等的那一面，或者说中项走入两个端项，这两个端项作为端项互相对立，其中一个只是被承认者，另一个只是承认者。

en: Self-consciousness is at first simple being-for-itself, self-identical through excluding everything other from itself; its essence and absolute object is for it the I; and in this immediacy, or in this being of its being-for-itself, it is a singular individual.
What is other for it is an unessential object, marked with the character of the negative.
But the other is also a self-consciousness; one individual steps forth over against another individual.

Appearing thus immediately, they are for one another in the manner of common objects; independent shapes, consciousnesses sunk into the being of life — for here the existent object has determined itself as life — which have not yet accomplished for one another the movement of absolute abstraction, of annihilating all immediate being and being only the purely negative being of self-identical consciousness, or have not yet presented themselves to one another as pure being-for-itself, i.e. as self-consciousnesses.

Each is indeed certain of itself, but not of the other, and therefore its own certainty of itself still has no truth; for its truth would only be that its own being-for-itself had presented itself to it as an independent object, or, what is the same, that the object had presented itself as this pure certainty of itself.

But according to the concept of recognition this is not possible unless, just as the other is for it, it is for the other, and each in its own self accomplishes this pure abstraction of being-for-itself through its own doing and again through the doing of the other.
zh: 自我意识首先就是简单的自为存在，它通过把一切他者从自身排除出去而自身等同，它的本质和绝对对象对它来说就是“我”；而它在这种直接性中，或者说在它的自为存在的这种存在中，是单一者。
对它来说是他者的东西，则是非本质的、被标以否定这一特征的对象。
但另一个也是自我意识；一个个体出现在另一个个体的对面。
这样直接出现时，它们彼此之间就是普通对象的样子；它们是独立的形态，是沉入生命之存在的意识——因为在这里，存在着的对象已经把自己规定为生命——这些意识还没有为彼此完成绝对抽象的运动，即消灭一切直接存在、只成为自身等同的意识的纯粹否定的存在，或者说，它们还没有向彼此表明自己是纯粹的自为存在，即自我意识。
每一个虽然确信自己，但不确信另一个，因此它自己对自己的确定性还没有真理；因为它的真理只会是：它自己的自为存在已经向它表明自己是独立的对象，或者，同样可以说，对象已经表明自己是对自己的这种纯粹确定性。
但按照承认的概念，这只有在下述情况下才可能：就像另一个对它来说那样，它也对另一个来说如此，每一个都在自身身上、通过自己的行动、并又通过另一个的行动，完成自为存在的这种纯粹抽象。

en: But its presentation as the pure abstraction of self-consciousness consists in showing itself as the pure negation of its objective mode, or in showing that it is tied to no determinate being, not tied to the universal singleness of determinate being at all, not tied to life.
This presentation is the doubled doing: the doing of the other and the doing through itself.
Insofar as it is the doing of the other, each thus goes for the death of the other.
But in this the second, the doing through itself, is also present; for the former includes the staking of one's own life within itself.
The relation of the two self-consciousnesses is thus so determined that they prove themselves and one another through the struggle of life and death.
— They must enter into this struggle, for they must raise the certainty of themselves, of being for themselves, to truth in the other and in themselves.

And it is solely the staking of life through which freedom, through which it is proved that for self-consciousness not being, not the immediate manner in which it appears, not its being-sunk in the expanse of life is the essence — but that in it there is nothing that would not be for it a vanishing moment, that it is only pure being-for-itself.
The individual that has not risked life can indeed be recognized as a person; but it has not attained the truth of this recognition as that of an independent self-consciousness.

Just as each must go for the death of the other, so too does each stake its life; for the other no longer counts for it as itself; its essence presents itself to it as an other, it is outside itself, it must sublate its being-outside-itself; the other is a manifoldly entangled and existent consciousness; it must intuit its otherness as pure being-for-itself or as absolute negation.
zh: 但它把自己表明为自我意识的纯粹抽象，则在于它显示出自己是它的对象性方式的纯粹否定，或者说在于显示出它不系于任何特定的定在，根本不系于定在的普遍单一性，不系于生命。
这种表明是双重的行动：他者的行动，以及通过自身的行动。
就它是他者的行动而言，每一方便都冲着另一个的死亡而去。
但在这里也有第二个行动，即通过自身的行动；因为前一个行动本身包含着拿自己的生命去冒险。
两个自我意识的关系因此是这样规定的：它们通过生死斗争来证实自己和彼此。
——它们必须进入这场斗争，因为它们必须把自身确信自己是自为存在这一确定性，在另一个身上和在自己身上提升为真理。
而且唯有拿生命去冒险，自由才由此、并且唯有由此才得到证实：对自我意识来说，本质不是存在，不是它出现的那种直接方式，不是它沉入生命之展开，——而是在它身上没有任何东西对它来说不是正在消失的环节，它只是纯粹的自为存在。
没有拿生命去冒险的个体，当然可以被承认为人格；但它还没有达到这种承认的真理，即作为独立自我意识而得到承认的真理。
同样，每一个都必须像它拿自己的生命去冒险那样，冲着另一个的死亡而去；因为另一个在它看来不再等于它自己；它的本质向它呈现为一个他者，它在自身之外，它必须扬弃自己的在自身之外；另一个是多种多样地被纠缠着的、存在着的意识；它必须把它的他在当作纯粹的自为存在或绝对的否定来直观。

en: But this proving through death sublates the truth that should have emerged from it, and therewith also the certainty of itself in general; for as life is the natural position of consciousness, independence without absolute negativity, so death is the natural negation of it, negation without independence, which therefore remains without the required meaning of recognition.
Through death the certainty has indeed come about that both risked their lives and despised it in themselves and in the other; but not for those who withstood this struggle.
They sublate the consciousness posited in this alien essentiality, which is natural determinate being, or they sublate themselves, and are sublated as the extremes that want to be for themselves.

But with this there vanishes from the play of alternation the essential moment of decomposing itself into extremes of opposed determinacies; and the middle collapses into a dead unity, which is decomposed into dead, merely existent, not opposed extremes; and the two do not give and receive themselves back from one another through consciousness, but only let one another go free indifferently, as things.
Their deed is abstract negation, not the negation of consciousness, which sublates in such a way that it preserves and retains what is sublated, and thereby survives its own being-sublated.
zh: 但这种通过死亡的证实，同样扬弃了本应从中产生出来的真理，并因此也扬弃了它对自己的确定性本身；因为正如生命是意识的自然立场，是没有绝对否定性的独立性，死亡就是意识的自然否定，是没有独立性的否定，因而这种否定仍然没有承认所要求的意义。
通过死亡固然产生了这样的确定性：两者都拿自己的生命去冒险，并在自己身上和在另一个身上轻视它；但这确定性不是为那些经受了这场斗争的人而有的。
它们扬弃了自己在这种陌生的本质性中——这种本质性就是自然的定在——被设定的意识，或者说，它们扬弃了自己，并作为那些想成为自为存在的端项而被扬弃。
但这样一来，从交替的游戏中就消失了那个本质的环节，即把自己分解为各种对立规定性的端项；而中项则塌缩为一个死的统一体，这个统一体被分解为死的、仅仅存在着的、并不对立的端项；两者也不再通过意识而互相给出和收回自身，而是仅仅无所谓地像物一样让彼此自由。
它们的行动是抽象的否定，而不是意识的否定，意识的否定这样扬弃，以致它把被扬弃的东西保存并保留下来，并因此活过了自己的被扬弃。

en: In this experience it becomes evident to self-consciousness that life is as essential to it as pure self-consciousness.
In immediate self-consciousness the simple I is the absolute object, which, however, for us or in itself is the absolute mediation and has subsisting independence as an essential moment.

The dissolution of that simple unity is the result of the first experience; through it a pure self-consciousness and a consciousness are posited, which is not purely for itself but for another, i.e. is as existent consciousness or consciousness in the shape of thinghood.

Both moments are essential; — since they are at first unequal and opposed, and their reflection into unity has not yet come about, they are as two opposed shapes of consciousness; the one the independent one, for which being-for-itself is the essence, the other the dependent one, for which life or being for another is the essence; the former is the master, the latter the slave.
zh: 在这种经验中，自我意识明白了：生命对它来说与纯粹自我意识同样是本质的。
在直接的自我意识中，简单的“我”是绝对对象，但这个对象对我们来说或自在说来是绝对的中介，并且把持存着的独立性当作本质的环节。
那个简单统一体的解体是第一个经验的结果；通过它，一个纯粹的自我意识和一个意识被设定起来，后者不是纯粹自为的，而是为他的，也就是说，是作为存在着的意识或具有物性形态的意识。
两个环节都是本质的；——由于它们最初是不平等的、对立的，而它们向统一中的反思还没有产生出来，所以它们是两个对立的意识的形态；一个是独立的意识的形态，自为存在是它的本质，另一个是不独立的意识的形态，生命或为他存在是它的本质；前者是主人，后者是奴隶。

en: The master is the being-for-itself consciousness, but no longer merely the concept of it, but a being-for-itself consciousness that is mediated with itself through another consciousness, namely through one whose essence it is to be synthesized with independent being or with thinghood in general.

The master relates himself to these two moments, to a thing as such, the object of desire, and to the consciousness for which thinghood is the essential; and since he is a) as the concept of self-consciousness the immediate relation of being-for-itself, but b) now at the same time mediation, or a being-for-itself that is for itself only through an other, he relates himself a) immediately to both and b) mediately to each through the other.

The master relates himself to the slave mediately through independent being; for it is precisely on this that the slave is held fast; it is his chain, from which he could not abstract in the struggle and therefore showed himself to be unindependent, to have his independence in thinghood.

But the master is the power over this being, for he showed in the struggle that it counts for him only as something negative; since he is the power over it, but this being is the power over the other, he thus in this inference has this other under himself.

Likewise the master relates himself mediately through the slave to the thing—; the slave relates himself as self-consciousness in general also negatively to the thing and sublates it; but it is at the same time independent for him, and he therefore cannot, through his negating, come to terms with it to the point of annihilation, or he only works on it.

For the master, by contrast, through this mediation the immediate relation becomes the pure negation of it, or enjoyment; what desire did not succeed in, he succeeds in, to come to terms with it and in enjoyment to satisfy himself.

Desire did not succeed in this because of the independence of the thing; but the master, who has inserted the slave between it and himself, thereby closes himself together only with the unindependence of the thing and enjoys it purely; the side of independence, however, he leaves to the slave, who works on it.
zh: 主人是自为存在着的意识，但不再只是自我意识的概念，而是自为存在着的意识，它通过另一个意识而与自身中介在一起，也就是通过这样一个意识，属于它的本质的是，它与独立的存在或一般物性综合在一起。
主人与这两个环节相关，与一个作为这样的物、即欲望的对象相关，也与那种以物性为本质东西的意识相关；而由于他 a) 作为自我意识的概念是自为存在的直接关系，但 b) 现在同时又是中介，或者说是一种只有通过一个他者才自为的自为存在，所以他 a) 直接地与两者相关，b) 则通过另一个而间接地与每一个相关。
主人通过独立的存在而间接地与奴隶相关；因为奴隶恰恰被系在这上面；这是他的锁链，他在斗争中不能不考虑这条锁链，因此表明自己是不独立的，表明自己的独立性存在于物性之中。
但主人是支配这种存在的权力，因为他在斗争中表明，这种存在对他只算是一种否定的东西；由于他是支配它的权力，而这种存在又是支配另一个人的权力，所以他就在这个推论中把另一个置于自己之下。
同样，主人通过奴隶而间接地与物相关——；奴隶作为一般的自我意识也否定地与物相关，并扬弃物；但物对他来说同时又是独立的，因此他通过自己的否定不能与物了结到消灭的地步，或者说他只是在加工物。
与此相反，对主人来说，通过这种中介，直接的关系成了对物的纯粹否定，也就是享受；欲望没有做到的事，他做到了，与物了结，并在享受中满足自己。
欲望没有做到这一点，是因为物的独立性；但主人把奴隶插在物和自己之间，由此只与物的不独立性结合在一起，纯粹地享受物；而独立性的一面，他则留给加工它的奴隶。

en: In these two moments his being-recognized by another consciousness comes about for the master; for in them this consciousness posits itself as unessential, once in the working of the thing, the other time in dependence on a determinate Dasein; in both it cannot become master over being and attain absolute negation.
Thus herein this moment of recognition is present, that the other consciousness sublates itself as being-for-itself and thereby itself does what the first does to it.

Likewise the other moment, that this doing of the second is the first's own doing; for what the slave does is properly the doing of the master; for the latter only being-for-itself, the essence, is; he is the pure negative power, for which the thing is nothing, and thus the pure essential doing in this relation; the slave, however, a not pure but unessential doing.
But for genuine recognition the moment is lacking, namely that what the master does toward the other, he also do toward himself, and what the slave does toward himself, he also do toward the other.
Thereby a one-sided and unequal recognition has come about.
zh: 在这两个环节中，主人得到了另一个意识对他的承认；因为这个意识在这两个环节中把自己设定为非本质的东西，一次是在对物的加工中，另一次是在对一个特定定在的依赖中；在两方面它都不能支配存在，不能达到绝对否定。
所以这里就存在着承认的这一环节：另一个意识把自己作为自为存在扬弃掉，并因此自己做出了第一个意识对它做的事。
同样还有另一个环节，即第二个意识的这种行动是第一个意识自己的行动；因为奴隶所做的，其实是主人的行动；对主人来说，只有自为存在才是本质；他是纯粹的否定权力，对他来说物什么都不是，因此他是这种关系中纯粹本质的行动；而奴隶的行动则不是纯粹的，而是非本质的行动。
但真正的承认还缺少这一环节，主人对另一个所做的，他也对自己做，而奴隶对自己所做的，他也对另一个做。
由此产生了一种片面的、不平等的承认。

en: In this, the unessential consciousness is for the master the object that makes up the truth of the certainty of himself.

But it is evident that this object does not correspond to its concept, but that in that wherein the master has accomplished himself, something quite other than an independent consciousness has rather become for him.

Not such a one is for him, but rather an unindependent one; he is thus not certain of being-for-itself as the truth, but his truth is rather the unessential consciousness and the unessential doing of the same.
zh: 在这种情形中，非本质的意识对主人来说是对象，这个对象构成了他自身确定性的真理。
但很明显，这个对象并不符合它的概念，反而在主人完成自身的那种东西里，对他来说变成的完全是另一种东西，而不是一个独立的意识。
对他来说存在的并不是这样一个东西，而毋宁是一个不独立的东西；所以他并不确信自为存在就是真理，毋宁说他的真理是非本质的意识和它的非本质行动。

en: The truth of the independent consciousness is accordingly the slavish consciousness.
This appears to be sure at first outside itself and not as the truth of self-consciousness.

But just as mastery showed that its essence is the reverse of what it wants to be, so slavery too will in its fulfilment become rather the opposite of what it immediately is; as consciousness driven back into itself, it will go into itself and turn itself around into true independence.
zh: 因此，独立意识的真理就是奴隶的意识。
这种意识虽然起初显得在自身之外，而不是自我意识的真理。
但正如主人地位表明，它的本质是它想成为的东西的反面，奴隶状态同样会在自己的完成中变成它直接所是的那个东西的对立面；它作为被逼回自身的意识将深入自身，并转变为真正的独立性。

en: We saw only what slavery is in the relation of mastery.
But it is self-consciousness, and what it is accordingly in and for itself is now to be considered.
At first, for slavery the master is the essence; thus the independent being-for-itself consciousness is for it the truth, which, however, is not yet on it.
But it in fact has this truth of pure negativity and of being-for-itself on itself, for it has experienced this essence on itself.
For this consciousness has had fear not about this or that, nor for this or that instant, but about its whole essence; for it has felt the fear of death, of the absolute master.
It has therein been inwardly dissolved, has utterly trembled in itself, and everything fixed has quaked in it.

But this pure universal movement, the absolute becoming-fluid of all subsistence, is the simple essence of self-consciousness, absolute negativity, pure being-for-itself, which is thereby on this consciousness.
This moment of pure being-for-itself is also for it, for in the master it is its object.

It is furthermore not only this universal dissolution in general, but in service it really accomplishes it; it therein sublates in all single moments its attachment to natural Dasein and works the same away.
zh: 我们只看到奴隶状态在主人地位的关系中是什么。
但它是自我意识，而它据此自在自为地是什么，现在就要来考察。
首先，对奴隶状态来说，主人是本质；所以独立的自为存在着的意识对它是真理，这个真理对它来说却还不在它身上。
但它实际上自身就具有这种纯粹否定性和自为存在的真理，因为它在自己身上经验到了这个本质。
因为这种意识曾经害怕的，不是这个或那个东西，也不是为这个或那个瞬间，而是为它的整个本质；因为它感受到了对死亡、对绝对主人的恐惧。
它在这里面从内里被消解了，彻底在自身中颤栗了，一切固定的东西都在它里面震动了。
但这种纯粹的普遍运动、一切持存的绝对流动化，却是自我意识的单纯本质，是绝对否定性，是纯粹的自为存在，它由此就存在于这个意识身上。
这个纯粹自为存在的环节对它来说也是存在的，因为在主人那里，这个环节是它的对象。
其次，它不仅仅是一般而言的这种普遍消解，而且在服役中它现实地完成了这种消解；它在这种服役中于所有个别环节上扬弃了自己对自然定在的依附，并把自然定在加工掉。

en: But the feeling of absolute power, both in general and in the particular of service, is only dissolution in itself, and although the fear of the master is the beginning of wisdom, consciousness therein is for itself, not being-for-itself.
But through work it comes to itself.

In the moment that corresponds to desire in the consciousness of the master, the side of the unessential relation to the thing seemed indeed to have fallen to the serving consciousness, in that the thing therein retains its independence.
Desire has reserved for itself the pure negating of the object, and thereby the unmingled self-feeling.
But this satisfaction is for that reason itself only a vanishing, for it lacks the objective side, or subsistence.
Work, by contrast, is inhibited desire, arrested vanishing, or it forms.
The negative relation to the object becomes the form of the object and something abiding, because precisely for the worker the object has independence.

This negative middle, or the formative activity, is at the same time the singularity, or the pure being-for-itself, of consciousness, which now in work steps outside itself into the element of permanence; the working consciousness therefore comes thereby to the intuition of independent being as its own self.
zh: 但绝对权力的感觉，无论一般而言还是在服务的个别情形中，都只是自在的消解，而且，虽然对主人的恐惧是智慧的开端，意识在其中却是为它自己的，而不是自为存在。
但通过劳动，它却回到了自身。
在主人意识中对应于欲望的那个环节里，与物发生非本质关系的那一面，看来确实落到了奴隶意识身上，因为物在其中保持着它的独立性。
欲望为自己保留了对象的纯粹否定，并由此保留了未掺杂的自我感。
但这种满足因此本身只是一种消逝，因为它缺少对象性的一面，或者说缺少持存。
劳动则相反，是被遏制的欲望，是被止住的消逝，或者说，它在塑造。
对对象的否定关系变成了对象的形式，变成一种持存的东西，因为对劳动者来说，对象恰恰具有独立性。
这种否定的中项，或者说这种赋形的活动，同时就是意识的个别性，或者说意识的纯粹自为存在，而它现在在劳动中走出自身，进入持存的元素；所以，劳动着的意识由此就达到对独立存在的直观，把独立存在直观为它自己。

en: But forming has not only this positive significance, that the serving consciousness therein becomes, as pure being-for-itself, something existing, but also the negative significance with respect to its first moment, fear.
For in the forming of the thing, its own negativity, its being-for-itself, becomes an object for it only in that it sublates the opposed existing form.
But this objective negative is precisely the alien essence before which it has trembled.
Now, however, it destroys this alien negative, posits itself as such into the element of permanence, and thereby becomes for itself a being-for-itself.

In the master, being-for-itself is for it an other, or only for it, in fear, being-for-itself is on it itself, in forming, being-for-itself becomes as its own for it, and it comes to the consciousness that it itself is in and for itself.
Through being posited outside, the form does not become for it an other than it; for precisely it is its pure being-for-itself, which therein becomes truth for it.
Thus through this finding-again of itself by itself it becomes its own sense, and precisely in the work, although it seemed therein to be only an alien sense.
– For this reflection, the two moments of fear and of service in general, as well as of forming, are necessary, and at the same time both in a universal manner.
Without the discipline of service and obedience, fear remains stuck at the formal and does not spread over the conscious actuality of determinate being.
Without forming, fear remains inward and mute, and consciousness does not become for itself.

If consciousness forms without the first absolute fear, it is only a vain sense of its own; for its form or negativity is not negativity in itself; and its forming can therefore not give it the consciousness of itself as the essence.
If it has endured not the absolute fear but only some anxiety, the negative essence has remained an external thing for it, its substance is not thoroughly infected by it.

Since not all the fulfilments of its natural consciousness have become unstable, it still belongs in itself to determinate being; its own sense is self-will, a freedom that still remains within bondage.

As little as the pure form can become its essence, so little is it, considered as extension over the singular, universal forming, absolute concept, but a skill that is powerful only over some things, not over the universal power and the whole objective essence.
zh: 但赋形不仅具有这种积极的意义，即奴隶意识在其中作为纯粹的自为存在而成为存在者，而且还具有针对它的第一个环节即恐惧的消极意义。
因为在塑造物时，它自己的否定性、它的自为存在，只有通过它扬弃那对立的存在着的形式，才成为它的对象。
但这个对象性的否定者，恰恰就是它曾在其面前颤抖的那个陌生本质。
但现在它摧毁了这个陌生的否定者，把自己作为这样一个否定者设定到持存的元素之中，并由此对自己来说成为一个自为存在者。
在主人那里，自为存在对它来说是一个他者，或者说只是为它而存在，在恐惧中，自为存在就在它自己身上，在塑造中，自为存在作为它自己的东西而对它存在，于是它达到这样的意识，即它自己就是自在自为的。
形式由于被设置到外面，对它来说并不成为一个与它不同的他者，因为它恰恰就是它的纯粹自为存在，这自为存在在其中对它成为真理。
所以，通过这种由自己重新找到自己，它成了它自己的意义，而且恰恰是在劳动中，尽管它在其中看来只是陌生的意义。
——对于这种反思来说，恐惧和一般服务这两个环节以及塑造都是必要的，而且两者同时是以一种普遍的方式必要的。
没有服务和服从的管教，恐惧就停留在形式的东西上，不会扩展到定在的意识到的现实性之上。
没有塑造，恐惧就始终是内在的、沉默的，意识也不会成为为它自己的东西。
如果意识没有那最初的绝对恐惧就去塑造，那么它就只是一种虚浮的自己的意义；因为它的形式或否定性并不是自在的否定性；所以它的塑造不能给它关于自己作为本质的意识。
如果它经受的不是绝对的恐惧，而只是一些害怕，那么否定性的本质对它来说就始终是一个外在的东西，它的实体并没有被它彻底浸染。
由于它的自然意识的种种充实并没有全部动摇，它自在地仍属于特定的存在；自己的意义就是固执，是一种还停留在奴隶状态之内的自由。
正如纯粹形式不能成为它的本质，同样，如果就它扩展到个别东西之上来看，它也不是普遍的塑造、绝对的概念，而是一种技巧，这种技巧只对某些东西有掌控力，对普遍的权力和整个对象性的本质却没有这种掌控力。

34.en: B. Freedom of Self-Consciousness; Stoicism, Scepticism and the Unhappy Consciousness
34.zh: B. 自我意识的自由；斯多葛主义、怀疑论和苦恼意识

en: For independent self-consciousness, on the one hand, only the pure abstraction of the 'I' is its essence, and on the other hand, in that it develops itself and gives itself differences, this distinguishing does not become for it an objective, in-itself-existing essence; this self-consciousness therefore does not become an 'I' that truly distinguishes itself in its simplicity, or remains equal to itself in this absolute distinction.

Consciousness driven back into itself, by contrast, becomes an object for itself in forming, as the form of the formed things, and in the master it intuits being-for-itself at the same time as consciousness.
But for the serving consciousness as such, these two moments – of itself as an independent object, and of this object as a consciousness and thereby of its own essence – fall apart.

But since for us, or in itself, form and being-for-itself are the same, and in the concept of independent consciousness being-in-itself is consciousness, the side of being-in-itself, or of thinghood, which the form received in work, is no other substance than consciousness, and a new shape of self-consciousness has come to be for us; a consciousness that is its essence as the infinity or pure movement of consciousness; that thinks, or is free self-consciousness.

For to be an object to oneself, or to comport oneself toward the objective essence in such a way that it has the significance of the being-for-itself of the consciousness for which it is, not as abstract 'I' but as 'I' that at the same time has the significance of being-in-itself, this is called thinking.

– For thinking, the object does not move in representations or shapes, but in concepts, i.e. in a differentiated being-in-itself that immediately, for consciousness, is not a differentiated thing from it.

The represented, the formed, the existing as such has the form of being something other than consciousness; but a concept is at the same time an existing thing, and this difference, insofar as it is on it itself, is its determinate content, – but in that this content is at the same time a comprehended one, consciousness remains immediately aware of its unity with this determinate and differentiated existing thing, not as with representation, in which it must first still especially recollect that this is its representation, but the concept is immediately my concept.

In thinking I am free, because I am not in an other, but remain absolutely with myself, and the object that is the essence for me is, in undivided unity, my being-for-me; and my movement in concepts is a movement in myself.

– But in this determination of this shape of self-consciousness it is essential to hold fast to this, that it is thinking consciousness in general, or that its object is the immediate unity of being-in-itself and being-for-itself.

The consciousness that is same-named with itself, which repels itself from itself, becomes for itself an in-itself-existing element, but this element is for it only first as universal essence in general, not as this objective essence in the development and movement of its manifold being.
zh: 对独立的自我意识来说，一方面，只有自我的纯粹抽象是它的本质，另一方面，当它展开自身并给自己种种差别时，这种区分对它来说并不成为一种对象性的、自在存在着的本质；所以，这种自我意识不会成为一个在它的单纯性中真正区分自身、或者说在这种绝对区分中保持自身等同的自我。
被逼回自身之中的意识则相反，在赋形中作为被塑造的物的形式而成为自己的对象，并且在主人身上，它同时把自为存在直观为意识。
但对奴隶意识本身来说，这两个环节——它自己作为独立的对象，以及这个对象作为意识并因此作为它自己的本质——却分裂开来。
但是，既然对我们来说或自在地说，形式和自为存在是同一个东西，而且在独立意识的概念中，自在存在就是意识，那么，自在存在的一面，或者说形式在劳动中所获得的物性那一面，就不是什么不同于意识的实体，于是对我们来说就产生了一种自我意识的新形态；这是一种把意识的无限性或纯粹运动当作自己本质的意识；它在思，或者说，它就是自由的自我意识。
因为，所谓思，就是不是作为抽象的自我，而是作为同时具有自在存在意义的自我而成为自己的对象，或者这样对待对象性的本质，即让它具有它为之而存在的那个意识的自为存在的意义。
——对思来说，对象并不是在表象或形态中运动，而是在概念中运动，也就是说，在一种被区分开的自在存在中运动，而这种自在存在直接而言对意识并不是与意识不同的东西。
被表象的东西、被塑形的东西、存在者本身，具有这样的形式：它是不同于意识的东西；但概念同时是一个存在者，而这种差别，就它自在而言，就是它的特定内容，——但是，由于这个内容同时是一个被概念把握的内容，它就直接意识到自己与这个特定的、被区分开的存在者的统一，而不像在表象那里，在表象中它还必须特别地回忆起这就是它的表象，相反，概念直接就是我的概念。
在思中我是自由的，因为我不是在一个他者之中，而是绝对停留在我自己那里，并且那个对我而言是本质的对象，在不可分割的统一中就是我的为我存在；而我在概念中的运动，就是在自身之中的运动。
——不过，在自我意识这一形态的这个规定中，本质上必须紧紧抓住这一点，即它就是一般的思着的意识，或者说，它的对象是自在存在和自为存在的直接统一。
这个与自身同名的意识，把自身从自己那里排斥开，对它来说就成了自在存在着的元素，但这一元素对它来说还只是作为一般的普遍本质，而不是作为在其杂多的存在的展开和运动中的这个对象性的本质。

en: This freedom of self-consciousness has, as is well known, been called Stoicism, in that it has appeared in the history of spirit as an appearance conscious of it.

Its principle is that consciousness is a thinking essence, and that something has essentiality for it, or is true and good for it, only in so far as consciousness therein comports itself as a thinking essence.
zh: 自我意识的这种自由，众所周知，当它作为意识到了这种自由的现象而出现在精神的历史上时，就被称为斯多葛主义。
它的原则是，意识是思维着的本质，而某物只有在意识于其中作为思维着的本质而行事时，才对意识具有本质性，或者才是真的和善的。

en: The manifold, self-differentiating expansion, singularization and entanglement of life is the object against which desire and work are active.
This manifold doing has now contracted itself into the simple distinction that is in the pure movement of thinking.

Not the difference that is present as a determinate thing, or as consciousness of a determinate natural determinate being, as a feeling, or as desire and purpose for the same, whether it be posited by one's own or by a foreign consciousness, has essentiality any longer, but solely the difference that is a thought one, or that is immediately not distinguished from me.

This consciousness is therefore negative toward the relation of lordship and bondage; its doing is not to have its truth on the slave in lordship, nor as slave to have its truth in the will of the master and in its serving, but to be free as on the throne so in chains, in every dependence of its singular determinate being, and to preserve for itself the lifelessness that constantly withdraws from the movement of determinate being, from acting as from suffering, into the simple essentiality of thought.

Self-will is the freedom that fixes itself on a singularity and stands within bondage, whereas Stoicism is the freedom that immediately always comes forth from it and returns into the pure universality of thought, and as universal form of the world-spirit could appear only in the time of a universal fear and bondage, but also of a universal formation that had heightened forming to thinking.
zh: 生命那杂多的、在自身中区分着自身的展开、个别化和纠缠，就是欲望和劳动所作用的那个对象。
这种杂多的行为现在收缩成了单纯的区分，而这种区分就在思维的纯粹运动之中。
不再具有本质性的，不是那种差别——它作为特定的物，或作为对某种特定自然定在的意识，作为情感，或作为对同一个东西的欲望和目的而存在，无论它是由自己的意识还是由一个陌生的意识设定的——而只有那种被思维的、或者直接说来与我并无区别的差别。
所以，这种意识对主人与奴隶的关系采取否定的态度；它的行为不是要在主人身份中于奴隶身上拥有自己的真理，也不是要作为奴隶在主人的意志和它自己的服务中拥有自己的真理，而是要像在宝座上一样在枷锁中、在它个别定在的一切依赖中都是自由的，并且要为自己保持那种无生命性，这种无生命性不断地从定在的运动中、从作用中如同从受苦中，退回思想的单纯本质性之中。
固执是那种把自己固定在某种个别性上、并停留在奴隶状态之内的自由，而斯多葛主义则是那种直接地总是从奴隶状态中出来、又回到思想的纯粹普遍性中去的自由，它作为世界精神的普遍形式，只能出现在一个普遍恐惧和普遍奴隶状态的时代，但也是一个普遍教养的时代，这种教养已经把塑造提高到思维。

en: Now although for this self-consciousness neither an other than it nor the pure abstraction of the 'I' is the essence, but the 'I' that has otherness on it, though only as thought difference, so that in its otherness it has immediately returned into itself, yet this its essence is at the same time only an abstract essence.
The freedom of self-consciousness is indifferent toward natural determinate being, has therefore let the latter go just as freely, and the reflection is a doubled one.

Freedom in thought has only pure thought as its truth, which is without the fulfilment of life, and is therefore also only the concept of freedom, not living freedom itself; for for it only thinking in general is as yet the essence, the form as such, which has withdrawn from the independence of things back into itself.

But in that individuality, as acting, was to present itself livingly, or, as thinking, was to grasp the living world as a system of thought, there would have to lie in thought itself, for the former expansion, a content of what is good, and for the latter, of what is true; so that in what is for consciousness there would be no other ingredient than the concept, which is the essence.
But just as it here separates itself off as abstraction from the manifoldness of things, it has no content on itself, but a given one.

Consciousness no doubt annihilates the content as a foreign being, in that it thinks it; but the concept is a determinate concept, and this determinacy of the same is the foreign element that it has on it.
Stoicism therefore came into embarrassment when it was asked, as the phrase went, for the criterion of truth in general, that is, properly, for a content of thought itself.
To the question put to it, what is good and true, it again gave contentless thinking itself as answer: the true and the good are to consist in rationality.

But this self-sameness of thinking is again only the pure form, in which nothing determines itself; the universal words about the true and the good, about wisdom and virtue, at which it must stop, are therefore indeed in general edifying, but because in fact they can come to no expansion of content, they soon begin to produce boredom.
zh: 不过，虽然对这种自我意识来说，本质既不是一个与它不同的他者，也不是自我的纯粹抽象，而是自我，它在自己身上具有他在，不过只是作为被思维的差别，以致它在自己的他在中直接回到了自身，然而它的这个本质同时只是一个抽象的本质。
自我意识的自由对自然的定在漠不关心，因此也自由地放开了这种定在，而反思则是双重的。
思想中的自由只以纯粹的思想为它的真理，而这种真理没有生命的充实，因此它也只是自由的概念，不是活生生的自由本身；因为对它来说，还只有一般的思维是本质，即那种形式本身，这种形式已经从物的独立性那里退回自身之中。
但是，既然个体性作为行动着的应当生动地呈现自身，或者作为思维着的应当把活生生的世界把握为一个思想体系，那么在思想本身之中就必须为前一种展开有一个关于什么是善的内容，为后一种有一个关于什么是真的内容；从而使凡是对意识而言存在的东西里面，除了那作为本质的概念，完全不会有别的成分。
可是，它在这里作为对物的杂多的抽象而分离出来，它自身就没有内容，而只有一个被给予的内容。
意识固然把内容当作一种陌生的存在加以消灭，因为它思考这内容；但概念是特定的概念，而概念的这种规定性就是它在自己身上具有的陌生东西。
所以，斯多葛主义在像当时的说法那样被问及一般的真理标准时，就陷入了窘境，也就是说，实际上是被问及思想本身的内容。
对于向它提出的什么是善和真的这一问题，它又拿无内容的思想本身作为回答：真的东西和善的东西应当存在于合理性之中。
但思想的这种自身等同又只是纯粹的形式，在其中没有什么得到规定；那些关于真的东西和善的东西、关于智慧和德行的普遍字眼，它必须停留在这些字眼上，因此虽然在一般意义上令人振奋，但由于它们实际上无法达到内容的任何展开，很快就让人感到无聊。

en: This thinking consciousness, just as it has determined itself, as abstract freedom, is therefore only the incomplete negation of otherness; withdrawn from determinate being only into itself, it has not accomplished itself on itself as the absolute negation of the same.
The content indeed counts for it only as thought, but therein also as determinate, and determinacy as such at the same time.
zh: 这种思维着的意识，正如它已经把自己规定为抽象的自由那样，因此只是对他在的未完成的否定；它只是从定在退回自身之中，并没有在自己身上把自己完成为对定在的绝对否定。
内容对它来说固然只是作为思想才有效，但同时又是作为特定的东西才有效，而规定性本身也同样如此。

en: Scepticism is the realization of that of which Stoicism is only the concept – and the actual experience of what the freedom of thought is; it is in itself the negative and must present itself as such.

With the reflection of self-consciousness into the simple thoughts of itself, independent determinate being, or abiding determinacy, has in fact fallen out of infinity over against it; in scepticism, the complete unessentiality and non-independence of this other now becomes a fact for consciousness; thought becomes the complete thinking that annihilates the being of the manifoldly determinate world, and the negativity of free self-consciousness will become real negativity on this manifold shaping of life.

– It is evident that, just as Stoicism corresponds to the concept of independent consciousness, which appeared as the relation of lordship and bondage, so scepticism corresponds to the realization of the same as the negative direction toward otherness, of desire and of work.

But if desire and work could not carry out the negation for self-consciousness, then on the contrary this polemical direction against the manifold independence of things will be successful, because it turns against them as free self-consciousness completed beforehand in itself; more precisely, because it has thinking or infinity on itself and herein the independences according to their difference are for it only vanishing magnitudes.
The differences, which in the pure thinking of itself are only the abstraction of differences, here become all differences, and all differentiated being a difference of self-consciousness.
zh: 怀疑论是那种东西的实在化，而斯多葛主义只是那种东西的概念，——它也是关于思想的自由是什么的现实经验；这种自由自在地就是否定性的东西，因而必然这样表现出来。
随着自我意识反思到它自身的单纯思想之中，独立的定在、或者说持续的规定性，实际上已经相对于它而从无限性中掉落出来；在怀疑论中，对意识来说，这个他者的彻底非本质性和非独立性现在就成了事实；思想变成了完整的、消灭那多重规定的世界的存在的思维，而自由自我意识的否定性将在这生命的杂多形态上成为实在的否定性。
——由此可见，正如斯多葛主义对应于独立意识的概念——这概念曾作为主人与奴隶的关系而出现——，怀疑论也同样对应于这种独立意识的实在化，即对应于那种朝向他在的否定方向，也就是欲望和劳动。
但是，如果欲望和劳动不能为自我意识实行这种否定，那么相反，这种针对物的多重独立性的论战方向就会取得成功，因为它作为在自身中事先完成了的自由自我意识而转向这些独立性；更确切地说，是因为它在自己身上具有思维或无限性，而在这里，那些独立性按照它们的差别对它来说只是正在消逝的量。
那些在它自身的纯粹思维中只是差别的抽象的差别，在这里变成了一切的差别，而一切被区分开的存在则变成了自我意识的一个差别。

en: Thereby the doing of scepticism in general and its manner have determined themselves.

It points out the dialectical movement that sense-certainty, perception and understanding are, as also the ignorance of that which in the relation of ruling and serving, and which for abstract thinking itself, counts as determinate.

That relation at the same time contains in itself a determinate manner in which ethical laws too are present as commands of lordship; the determinations in abstract thinking, however, are concepts of science, into which contentless thinking expands and attaches the concept in a manner that is in fact only external to the being that is independent of it, which constitutes its content, and has only determinate concepts as valid, be it that they are also pure abstractions.
zh: 由此，怀疑论一般的行为和它的方式就得到了规定。
它指出了那种辩证运动，即感性确定性、知觉和知性所是的那种辩证运动，同样也指出了那种无知：在统治和服务的关系中，以及在抽象思维本身那里，什么东西算作特定的东西。
那种关系同时也在自身中包含着一种特定的方式，在这种方式中，伦理的法则也作为主人的命令而存在；但抽象思维中的那些规定却是科学的概念，无内容的思想扩展到这些概念之中，并且以一种实际上只是外在的方式把概念挂到那种对它独立、并构成它的内容的存在上，而且只把特定的概念当作有效的概念，即使这些概念也是纯粹的抽象。

en: The dialectical element as negative movement, as it is immediately, appears to consciousness at first as something to which it is surrendered and which is not through consciousness itself.

As scepticism, by contrast, this movement is a moment of self-consciousness, to which it does not happen that its true and real element vanishes without its knowing how, but which in the certainty of its freedom lets this other, which gives itself out as real, itself vanish; not only the objective as such, but its own comportment to it, in which the objective counts and is made to count, hence also its perceiving as well as its fixing firm of what it is in danger of losing, the sophistry and its own true element determined and fixed out of itself; through which self-conscious negation it procures for itself the certainty of its freedom, brings forth the experience of the same, and thereby raises it to truth.
What vanishes is the determinate element, or the difference, which, in whatever way and from wherever it may be, sets itself up as something firm and unchangeable.

It has nothing abiding in it and must vanish for thinking, because the differentiated is precisely this, not to be in itself, but to have its essence only in an other; thinking, however, is insight into this nature of the differentiated, it is the negative essence as simple.
zh: 辩证的东西作为否定的运动，就它是直接的那样，最初显现给意识时，是某种意识被交付给它、而它却不是由意识本身而来的东西。

与此相反，作为怀疑论，这个运动则是自我意识的一个环节：自我意识并不会遇到这样的事，即它的真的东西和实在的东西在它不知道怎么回事的情况下消失掉，相反，它在自己自由的确定性中让这个冒充为实在的另一个东西自己消失掉；不只是让对象性的东西本身消失，也让它对对象性东西自己的态度消失——在这种态度中，对象性的东西被视为有效并被弄得有效——因而也让它的知觉以及它对它有危险失去的东西的固守消失，让诡辩以及它由自己规定并固定下来的真的东西消失；通过这种自我意识的否定，它为它自己取得了它自由的确定性，产生出对这种自由的经验，并由此把它提高到真理。
消失掉的是被规定的东西或差别，不论它以何种方式、从何处而来，它都把自己建立为固定不变的东西。
它身上没有持久的东西，它必须对思维消失，因为被区分者恰恰就是这样：不在它自身那里，而只在另一个东西里拥有自己的本质；但思维就是对被区分者的这种本性的洞见，思维就是作为单纯者的否定性本质。

en: The sceptical self-consciousness therefore experiences, in the change of everything that wants to become firm for it, its own freedom as something given and preserved through itself; it is for itself this ataraxia of thinking itself, the unchangeable and true certainty of itself.

It does not emerge from something alien, which has collapsed the manifold development of that something into itself, as a result that would have its becoming behind it; rather, consciousness itself is the absolute dialectical unrest, this mixture of sensuous and thought representations, whose differences collapse and whose equality likewise – for it is itself the determinacy against the unequal – again dissolves.
But precisely in this, instead of being self-same consciousness, this consciousness is in fact only a thoroughly contingent confusion, the dizziness of a disorder that keeps producing itself.
It is this for itself; for it itself preserves and brings forth this self-moving confusion.

It therefore also confesses to this, it confesses to being a wholly contingent, singular consciousness – a consciousness that is empirical, that directs itself by what has no reality for it, that obeys what is no essence to it, that does and brings into actuality what has no truth for it.

But just as in this way it counts as singular, contingent, and in fact animal life and lost self-consciousness, so on the contrary it also makes itself again into the universal, self-same one, for it is the negativity of all singularity and all difference.

From this self-sameness, or rather in it, it falls back again into that contingency and confusion, for precisely this self-moving negativity has to do only with the singular and drives itself around with the contingent.

This consciousness is therefore this unconscious twaddle, of passing over and back from the one extreme of self-same self-consciousness to the other of contingent, confused and confusing consciousness.

It itself does not bring these two thoughts of itself together; it recognizes its freedom at one time as elevation above all confusion and all contingency of determinate being, and confesses itself just as much the other time again as a falling back into unessentiality and as a driving about within it.

It lets the unessential content vanish in its thinking, but precisely therein it is the consciousness of an unessential element; it pronounces the absolute vanishing, but the pronouncing is, and this consciousness is the pronounced vanishing; it pronounces the nullity of seeing, hearing, etc., and it itself sees, hears, etc., it pronounces the nullity of the ethical essences and itself makes them into the powers of its acting.

Its doing and its words always contradict each other, and it itself likewise has the doubled, contradictory consciousness of unchangeableness and equality and of complete contingency and inequality with itself.
But it holds this contradiction of itself apart and comports itself over it as in its purely negative movement in general.

If equality is shown to it, it points out inequality; and when this inequality, which it has just pronounced, is now held up to it, it passes over to pointing out equality; its talk is in fact a squabble of stubborn boys, one of whom says A when the other says B, and again B when the other says A, and who buy for themselves, through the contradiction with themselves, the joy of remaining in contradiction with each other.
zh: 所以，怀疑论的自我意识在一切想对它固定下来的东西的变换中，经验到它自己的自由是由它自己给出并保持的；对它来说，这种自己思自己的不动心就是它自己那种不变而真正的确定性。
它不是从某个陌生的东西——那东西把自身多方面的展开收拢到自己里面——中作为一个把自身生成抛在背后的结果产生出来的；相反，意识本身就是绝对的辩证的不安，就是感性的表象和思想到的表象的这种混合，这些表象的差别归于消失，而它们的相等也同样——因为它本身就是针对不相等者的那个规定性——重新消解掉。
但恰恰在这一点上，这种意识实际上并不是自身等同的意识，而只是一种完全偶然的混乱，是一种不断自己产生出来的无序的眩晕。
这对它自己是如此；因为它自己保持并产生出这种自己运动着的混乱。
因此它也承认这一点，它承认自己是一种完全偶然的、个别的意识——一种经验性的意识，它按照对它没有实在性的东西来行事，听从对它不是本质的东西，做并把对它没有真理的东西带到现实性中。
但正如它这样把自己当作个别的、偶然的、实际上是动物性的生命和失去了自身的自我意识，它反过来也又把自己弄成普遍的、自身等同的东西，因为它是所有个别性和所有差别的否定性。
从这种自身等同中，或者毋宁说在它之中，它又重新落回那种偶然性和混乱，因为恰恰这种自己运动着的否定性只与个别的东西打交道，围着偶然的东西打转。
所以，这种意识就是这种无意识的胡言乱语：从自身等同的自我意识这一个极端，转到偶然的、混乱的并且造成混乱的意识那另一个极端，又转回来。
它自己并不把关于它自己的这两个思想合到一起；它一会儿把自己的自由认作对定在的一切混乱和一切偶然性的超出，并且同样又一次承认自己重新落回非本质性之中并在其中四处游荡。
它让非本质的内容在它的思维中消失，但恰恰因此它就是某种非本质之物的意识；它说出绝对的消失，但说出本身存在着，而这种意识就是被说出的消失；它说出看、听等等的虚无性，而它自己却看、听等等，它说出伦理的本质的虚无性，却自己把它们弄成它行动的力量。
它的行为和它的话总是互相矛盾，它自己也同样有那双重的、自相矛盾的意识：既意识到不变性和相等，又意识到完全的偶然性和不相等。
但它把自身这种矛盾分开来持守，并像在它一般的纯粹否定的运动中那样对待这种矛盾。
如果向它指出相等，它就指出不相等；而当它刚刚说出的这种不相等现在被摆到它面前时，它就转到指出相等上去；它这番言论实际上就是固执孩子们的争吵，一个说 A，另一个就说 B，另一个说 A 时这一个又说 B，他们靠与自身的矛盾换来彼此继续处在矛盾中的快乐。

en: In scepticism consciousness truly experiences itself as a consciousness that contradicts itself; out of this experience a new shape emerges, which brings together the two thoughts that scepticism holds apart.
The thoughtlessness of scepticism about itself must vanish, because it is in fact a consciousness that has these two ways on it.

Hereby this new shape is one that is for itself the doubled consciousness of itself as self-liberating, unchangeable and self-same, and of itself as absolutely self-confusing and self-inverting, and is the consciousness of this its contradiction.

– In stoicism self-consciousness is the simple freedom of itself; in scepticism it realizes itself, annihilates the other side of determinate being, but instead doubles itself and is now for itself a twofold.

Hereby the doubling that formerly distributed itself over two singulars, over the master and the slave, has turned inward into one; the doubling of self-consciousness within itself, which is essential in the concept of spirit, is hereby present, but not yet its unity, and the unhappy consciousness is the consciousness of itself as the doubled, merely contradictory essence.
zh: 在怀疑论里，意识真正经验到自己是一种自相矛盾的意识；从这种经验中产生出一个新形态，它把怀疑论分开持守的两个思想合到一起。
怀疑论对自身的思想贫乏必须消失，因为它实际上是一种意识，这种意识在它身上具有这两种方式。
由此，这个新形态就是这样一种东西：它自为地具有双重的意识，既意识到自己是解放自己的、不变的和自身等同的，又意识到自己是绝对地造成混乱和颠倒的，并且它就是对自己这一矛盾的意识。
——在斯多葛主义里，自我意识是它自己的单纯自由；在怀疑论里，这种自由把自己实在化，消灭了定在的另一面，但却毋宁说把自己双重化，现在对自己来说是一个二重的东西。
由此，先前分在两个个别者即主人和奴隶身上的双重化，已经转回到一个东西之内；自我意识在自身之内的双重化，这种在精神的概念中本质性的双重化，于是已经存在，但还不是它们的统一，而苦恼意识就是对自己作为双重化的、仅仅矛盾着的本质的意识。

en: This unhappy, inwardly divided consciousness must therefore, because this contradiction of its essence is a consciousness to it, always have the other in the one consciousness too, and so be driven out again immediately from each, just when it thinks it has come to the victory and rest of unity.

But its true return into itself, or its reconciliation with itself, will present the concept of spirit that has become living and entered into existence, because on it there already is this, that as an undivided consciousness it is a doubled one: it itself is the looking of one self-consciousness into another, and it itself is both, and the unity of both is also the essence to it; but for itself it is not yet this essence itself, not yet the unity of both.
zh: 所以，这种苦恼的、自身分裂的意识，既然它本质的这一矛盾对它是一个意识，就必须在这一个意识里也总是有另一个意识，并且就这样从每一个意识那里立刻被重新赶出去，正当它以为已经达到统一体的胜利和安宁的时候。
但它真正的返回自身，或者说它与自身的和解，将会呈现出已经变成活生生的、已经进入存在的精神的概念，因为在它身上已经有了这一点：它作为未被分割的意识是一个双重化的意识：它自己就是一个自我意识向另一个自我意识的观看，它自己就是两者，而两者的统一对它也是本质；但它自为地还不是这个本质本身，还不是两者的统一。

en: In that it is at first only the immediate unity of both, but for it the two are not the same but opposed, the one, namely the simple unchangeable, is for it the essential; the other, however, the manifold changeable, is for it the unessential.

Both are for it essences alien to each other; it itself, because it is the consciousness of this contradiction, places itself on the side of the changeable consciousness and is for itself the unessential; but as consciousness of unchangeableness or of the simple essence it must at the same time aim at freeing itself from the unessential, that is, from itself.

For although for itself it is indeed only the changeable, and the unchangeable is something alien to it, it is itself simple and hence unchangeable consciousness, conscious of this as its essence, yet in such a way that it itself, for itself, is again not this essence.

The position that it gives to both can therefore not be an indifference of the two toward each other, that is, not an indifference of itself toward the unchangeable; rather it is immediately itself both, and the relation of the two is for it a relation of the essence to the non-essence, so that this latter is to be sublated; but since both are equally essential and contradictory to it, it is only the contradictory movement, in which the opposite does not come to rest in its opposite, but in it is only newly produced as opposite.
zh: 由于它首先只是两者的直接统一，但两者对它并不是同一个东西，而是对立的东西，所以两者中的一个，即单纯的不变者，对它来说是本质的；而另一个，即杂多的可变者，对它来说是非本质的。
两者对它来说是彼此陌生的本质；它自己，因为它是这一矛盾意识，就站到可变意识那一边，并自为地是非本质的；但作为不变性或者说单纯本质的意识，它同时必须致力于从非本质的东西、即从它自己那里解放出来。
因为，虽然它自为地确实只是可变者，而不变者对它是某种陌生的东西，它自己却是单纯的、因而也是不变的意识，并意识到这一点是它的本质，但又是这样：它自己自为地重新不是这个本质。
所以，它给两者安排的位置不可能是一种两者彼此之间的漠不相关，也就是说，不可能是它自己对不变者的漠不相关；相反，它直接就是两者，而两者的关系对它来说就是本质对非本质的关系，以至于后者是要被扬弃的；但由于两者对它同等本质又互相矛盾，它就只是那矛盾的运动：在这种运动中，对立面并不在自己的对立面中达到安宁，而只是在其中作为对立面重新产生出来。

en: Thereby a struggle against an enemy is present, a struggle in which victory is rather a succumbing, and to have attained the one is rather the loss of it in its opposite.

The consciousness of life, of its determinate being and doing, is only the pain over this determinate being and doing, for in it, it has only the consciousness of its opposite as the essence, and of its own nullity.
It passes over into the elevation out of this to the unchangeable.
But this elevation is itself this consciousness; it is therefore immediately the consciousness of the opposite, namely of itself as singularity.

The unchangeable that enters into consciousness is thereby at the same time touched by singularity and is present only along with it; instead of having extinguished this singularity in the consciousness of the unchangeable, it only ever emerges in it.
zh: 因此，这里就出现了一场针对敌人的斗争，在这场斗争中，胜利毋宁说是一种屈服，而赢得了这一个，毋宁说就是在自己的对立面中失去了它。
生命的意识，即它的定在和行动的意识，只是对这种定在和行动的痛苦，因为它在这里只有对其对立面作为本质的意识，以及对自己的虚无性的意识。
它由此过渡到向不变者的上升。
但这种上升本身就是这种意识；所以它直接就是对对立面的意识，即对自己作为个别性的意识。
进入意识中的不变者，正因此同时也被个别性所触动，并且只与个别性一起是当前的；个别性并没有在不变者的意识中被消灭，反而总是在其中不断产生出来。

en: But in this movement it experiences precisely this emergence of singularity on the unchangeable, and of the unchangeable on singularity.
Singularity in general on the unchangeable essence, and at the same time its own singularity on it, become for it.
For the truth of this movement is precisely the being-one of this doubled consciousness.
But this unity itself first becomes for it one in which the diversity of the two is still the ruling element.
Thereby the threefold way in which singularity is linked with the unchangeable is present for it.
The one time, it itself again emerges for itself as opposed to the unchangeable essence, and it is thrown back into the beginning of the struggle, which remains the element of the whole relation.
The other time, however, the unchangeable itself has singularity on it for it, so that this singularity is a shape of the unchangeable, to which thereby the whole manner of existence passes over.
The third time, it finds itself as this singular thing in the unchangeable.

The first unchangeable is for it only the alien essence that condemns singularity; since the other is a shape of singularity like itself, it becomes thirdly spirit, has the joy of finding itself therein, and becomes conscious that its singularity is reconciled with the universal.
zh: 但在这场运动中，它恰好经验到个别性在不变者身上的这种显露，以及不变者在个别性身上的显露。
于是，对它来说，一般而言的个别性出现在不变的本质身上，同时它自己的个别性也出现在不变者身上。
因为这场运动的真理，恰恰就是这种双重意识的合而为一。
但这种统一对它来说首先本身就成了这样一种统一，在其中，两者的差异还是占主导的东西。
由此对它来说就存在着三重方式，即个别性如何与不变者相联结。
一次，它自己又作为与不变的本质相对立的东西为自己产生出来，并且被抛回到那场斗争的开端，而这场斗争始终是整个关系的要素。
但另一次，对它来说，不变者本身在它自己身上拥有个别性，以至于个别性成了不变者的形态，而存在的整个方式也就由此过渡到不变者身上。
第三次，它在不变者中发现自己就是这个个别东西。
第一个不变者对它来说只是那陌生的、判决个别性的本质；既然另一个是像它自己一样的个别性的形态，那么它第三次就成为精神，以在其中找到自己为快乐，并且意识到自己的个别性与普遍东西已经和解。

en: What here presents itself as the way and relation of the unchangeable has turned out to be the experience that the divided self-consciousness makes in its unhappiness.

This experience is, to be sure, not its one-sided movement, for it is itself unchangeable consciousness, this latter thereby at the same time also singular consciousness, and the movement is just as much a movement of the unchangeable consciousness, which appears in it as much as the other; for it runs its course through these moments: first, unchangeable [consciousness] opposed to the singular in general, then itself singular opposed to the other singular, and finally being one with it.

But this consideration, insofar as it belongs to us, is untimely here, for up to now only unchangeableness as unchangeableness of consciousness has arisen for us, which is therefore not the true unchangeableness but one still afflicted with an opposition, not the unchangeable in and for itself; we therefore do not know how this will comport itself.
What has here resulted is only this, that for the consciousness that is here our object, these indicated determinations appear on the unchangeable.
zh: 这里表现为不变者的方式和关系的东西，表明自己就是那分裂的自我意识在其苦恼中所获得的经验。
这种经验当然不是它单方面的运动，因为它本身就是不变的意识，这不变的意识因此同时也是个别的意识，而这个运动同样是不变的意识的运动，后者在其中出场，正如另一个也出场一样；因为它经历这些环节：首先是不变的意识与一般而言的个别东西相对立，然后它自己作为个别东西与另一个个别东西相对立，最后与它合为一体。
但这一考察，就它属于我们而言，在这里是不合时宜的，因为直到现在，对我们来说产生出来的只是作为意识的不变性的那种不变性，它因此不是真的不变性，而是还带有一种对立的不变性，还没有产生出自在自为的不变者本身；所以我们不知道它会怎样表现。
这里所得出的只是这一点：对在这里构成我们对象的那个意识来说，这些指出的规定就出现在不变者身上。

en: For this reason, therefore, the unchangeable consciousness also retains in its own shaping the character and the ground of being-divided and of being-for-itself over against the singular consciousness.

It is thereby, for this [consciousness], in general an event that the unchangeable receives the shape of singularity; just as it also only finds itself opposed to it and thus has this relation by nature; that it finally finds itself in it appears to it in part, to be sure, as brought about by itself, or as taking place because it is itself singular, but as a part of this unity, as belonging to the unchangeable, both as regards its origin and insofar as it is; and the opposition remains in this unity itself.

In fact, through the shaping of the unchangeable the moment of the beyond has not only remained but has rather been still further consolidated; for if through the shape of singular actuality it seems on the one hand to have been brought nearer to it, it is on the other hand now opposed to it as an opaque sensuous One with all the rigidity of an actual thing; the hope of becoming one with it must remain hope, i.e. without fulfilment and presentness; for between it and the fulfilment stands precisely absolute contingency, or immovable indifference, which lies in the shaping itself, the grounding element of the hope.

Through the nature of the existing One, through the actuality that it has attracted, it necessarily happens that it has vanished in time and has been in space and far away, and remains absolutely far away.
zh: 所以，正由于这个缘故，不变的意识在它自己的形态化中，也仍然保持着与个别意识相对立的分裂存在和自为存在的特征和基础。
因此，对它来说，不变者获得个别性的形态，一般而言就是一件发生的事情；正如它也发现自己只是与不变者相对立，因而凭本性就有这种关系一样；而它最终在不变者中找到自己这件事，在它看来，一部分虽然是由它自己产生出来的，或者是因为它自己是个别的才得以成立，但另一部分作为属于不变者的东西，却是这个统一的一部分，无论就这个统一的产生来说，还是就它存在而言；而对立就留在这个统一本身之中。

实际上，通过不变者的形态化，彼岸的环节不仅留了下来，反而更加牢固了；因为，虽说它通过个别现实性的形态，一方面看来被拉得离它更近了，另一方面现在却作为一个不透明的、感性的‘一’，带着一个现实之物的全部僵硬，与它相对而立；与它合为一体的希望，必须始终是希望，也就是说，没有实现，也没有当前；因为在它和实现之间，恰恰横着绝对的偶然性，或者说不可动摇的漠不相关，而它就存在于形态化本身之中，存在于为希望提供根据的东西之中。
由于存在着的‘一’的本性，由于它所吸引来的现实性，必然会发生这样的事：它在时间中已经消逝，在空间中曾经存在并且是遥远的，而且绝对地始终在远方。

en: If at first the mere concept of the divided consciousness determined itself in such a way that it aimed at the sublation of itself as singular and at becoming unchangeable consciousness, its striving now has this determination, that it rather sublates its relation to the pure, unshaped unchangeable and gives itself only the relation to the shaped unchangeable.

For the being-one of the singular with the unchangeable is now for it essence and object, just as in the concept only the shapeless, abstract unchangeable was the essential object; and the relation of this absolute being-divided of the concept is now that from which it has to turn away.
But the initially external relation to the shaped unchangeable as to a foreign actual thing, it has to elevate to absolute becoming-one.
zh: 如果说最初，分裂意识的那个单纯概念是这样规定自己的，即它要去扬弃自己作为个别东西、要去成为不变的意识，那么它的追求现在就有了这样的规定：它毋宁说要扬弃自己与纯粹未形态化的不变者的关系，只给自己保留对形态化了的不变者的关系。
因为个别东西与不变者的合而为一，现在对它是本质和对象，正如在概念中，只有无形态的、抽象的不变者才是本质性的对象；而概念这种绝对分裂存在所构成的关系，现在就是它必须转身离开的东西。
但它必须把起初还是外在的、与作为陌生现实之物的形态化不变者的关系，提升为绝对的合为一体。
